Standing practice: register every design export before attaching it anywhere, and archive designs (status 'archived') rather than expecting a delete tool - none exists.

rules.content: Storyboards are submitted for approval and never approved from an agent surface. Approval is the billing moment and belongs to a signed-in human in the dashboard. Never assemble the same video from single generated clips to route around the approval card.
Every design export, PNG or MP4, is registered in the Media Library before it is attached anywhere. An export URL with no media_assets row cannot be attached by id and counts as an open finding.
AI video clips cost about a dollar each against a 20 clip monthly cap. No clip is generated without its own written confirmation naming the cost and the remaining quota.
